question: What is the purpose of a Certificate of Completion of Subdivision and which body inspects it before endorsement to DHSUD?
answer: The purpose of a Certificate of Completion of Subdivision is to endorse a subdivision application that has been completed based on the approved plan to the Housing and Land Use Regulatory Board (HLURB). Before endorsement to DHSUD, it is inspected by the City Housing Land Use and Regulatory Unit (CHLURU) [S1].

ground_truth: The Certificate of Completion of Subdivision (COC) is a resolution from the City Housing Land Use and Regulatory Unit (CHLURU) favorably endorsing to DHSUD/HLURB that the project has been fully completed according to approved engineering plans.
